artworks.title: Landscape with a Farmhouse
artworks.artist: Dutch 17th Century, after Jacques de Gheyn II
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with a thatched-roof structure and a farmyard. The angle is elevated, showing fields, a farmhouse, and swirling clouds in the sky. The artwork is detailed with etching techniques, creating texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of gray. A cow and figures are visible in the foreground, engaging in tasks. The landscape extends into the distance with fields and trees.

artworks.title: Madonna Aldobrandini
artworks.description: The image shows a seated woman with two infants. The woman holds one infant on her lap, while the other infant stands next to her holding a staff. The woman has closed eyes and wears a headscarf and a draped garment. The infants have curly hair, with one reaching upward and the other holding a staff. The background features architectural elements and a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: The Virgin with a Fish
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people, most of whom are depicted from the waist up, gathered around a central figure seated on a raised platform. The central figure is a woman with gentle facial features, wearing a draped garment and a covering over her head. She is nurturing a young child, who is also partially draped, and they are both depicted with subtle smiles. To the left, an angelic figure with flowing hair and wings stands, seemingly in conversation with the central figure, while a kneeling young man holds a fish and reaches towards the woman. On the right, an older bearded man, wearing a long robe, holds a book open in his hands. The background features draped fabric overhead, creating a canopy effect, and there's a glimpse of a lion's head peeking out from the lower right.

artworks.title: Pandora Opening Her Box
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythical figures engaged in an allegorical scene. It presents a complex composition with several intricately detailed and elaborately posed figures. The central figure is a draped woman in motion, with her hand against her chin. To the left, another figure is working with a serpent emerging from a grotesque face on a pedestal, near books and paper. Above, there are celestial symbols in the sky, and another figure is propelling a chariot. The meticulous line work and shading provide texture and depth to the figures and their surroundings, creating a rich visual tapestry typical of classical allegorical themes.

artworks.title: Sirens, Naiads, and Tritons
artworks.description: This is a drawing of sea creatures riding waves. The image shows two human-like figures with serpent bodies on horses, one holding a staff and the other blowing a horn. A cherubic figure floats above them. Sea creatures and cherubic forms blend with the waves below. Intricate lines detail scales, waves, and hair, emphasizing the lively and fantastical nature of the scene.

artworks.title: Troops Resting
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures engaged in various activities in an outdoor setting. The scene features numerous figures dressed in historic costumes, gathered in a rustic landscape. Structures such as a tower or building are visible in the background, along with trees and a tent. The setting suggests a gathering where individuals are interacting, resting, or conversing. The style of the drawing is reminiscent of 18th-century etchings, with detailed line work capturing textures and expressions, creating a narrative of social interaction and leisure in a historical setting.

artworks.title: The Transfiguration
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 58 × 34.8 cm (22 13/16 × 13 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image is an etching featuring three standing figures and three kneeling figures, all shown from head to toe. The central standing figure appears elevated, with an aura around the head. The other two standing figures have more defined facial features and wear flowing garments. The kneeling figures display expressive postures with raised arms and tilted heads. They also have detailed facial features and wear robes with fabric folds. The background is textured, with hints of clouds and beams.

artworks.title: Hans van Aachen
artworks.artist: Jan Pietersz Saenredam after Pieter Isaacz
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 40.2 x 32.4 cm (15 13/16 x 12 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The engraving displays a portrait within an ornate architectural framework. The central figure faces slightly to the right, with a beard and curly hair mostly covered by a collar. The attire is elaborate with a high ruff and patterned fabric typical of the 17th or early 18th century. Surrounding him are sculptural figures posed with cadavers, classical figures, and cherubs. Above the portrait, a female figure holds scythes. The background features intricate entablature and pediments with Latin inscriptions. Classical architectural elements and allegorical emblems adorn the scene.

artworks.title: Hieronymus Alexander, Archbishop of Brindisi
artworks.description: The image depicts a detailed engraving of a man from the waist up. He is seated in a side profile with a contemplative expression. The man has a prominent nose and deep-set eyes, and he wears a robe with buttons. He is holding a book in his left hand, with a ring visible on his finger. In the background, there are shelves with closed books and a framed item, as well as pinned papers on the wall. The lower portion of the image includes inscribed text with the person's name and title.

artworks.title: The March of Silenus
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a gathering with satyrs and Bacchic figures. The scene captures figures in motion, suggesting a festival or ritual. The drawing shows various elements of Dionysian revelry, such as figures adorned with leaf crowns, playing instruments, holding plates, and interacting. Mythological creatures like a winged individual and a donkey-like animal are present. Around the central figures are wild animals like lions. A winding path leads into the distance, and there are architectural structures in the background adorned with draperies.

artworks.title: Bridge
artworks.description: The image shows an old ruin off-center, with a path leading up to it on the right. The horizon is in the upper third of the composition, with a sky suggesting light cloud cover. The style of the work creates texture and dimensionality in the stonework and foliage. Near the ruin, two figures are in a market setting, and two others are walking toward the ruins. In the distance are additional building structures. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of grey and black.

artworks.title: The Finding of Moses
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a baby in a basket surrounded by women and reeds. The scene shows a baby lying in a small basket among tall grasses or reeds, possibly in a natural setting like a river or stream. Several women are present around the baby, some reaching toward the baby. The women are depicted in flowing garments, and the scene conveys a sense of movement and attention. The use of lines and shading adds texture and depth to the scene, highlighting the vegetation and the figures' expressions and actions.

artworks.title: Saint John the Baptist Preaching
artworks.description: The image depicts a woodcut scene viewed from a slightly raised angle. There are rolling hills, rooftops, buildings, figures engaging in conversation on the left, and a group near a cave on the right. The artwork showcases intricate linework on trees, rocks, and clothing with a monochromatic color scheme emphasizing contrast and depth.

artworks.title: Pentecost
artworks.description: A group of people are sitting together with a dove above them. The scene depicts various figures gathered closely, seated and looking upwards towards a central point from which rays of light emanate. Above them, a dove is prominently positioned in the center, with light streaming downwards, creating a focal point. The figures are shown in expressive postures, some with hands raised, others in contemplative poses, and all appearing to be engaged in a shared experience. The clothing and style suggest a historical or religious context, lending a sense of reverence to the scene.

artworks.title: Pentecost
artworks.description: The image shows a group of individuals seated in a circular arrangement, displaying their entire bodies. The central figure sits with her hands in a prayer position, surrounded by mostly men who are seated and oriented towards one another. Each person is dressed in flowing garments resembling classical robes, with some figures appearing to have halos or tongues of flame above their heads. They have a range of facial hair and hairstyles. Above them hovers a dove radiating light, casting streams of light downwards towards the seated figures. The background is minimally detailed, emphasizing the beams of light fanning outwards from the dove, creating an ethereal atmosphere around the gathering.

artworks.title: Venus and Mars Embracing with Vulcan at his Forge
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene depicting mythological elements. The image shows figures in various poses within the setting. On the left, figures are draped on a bed with decorative drapery. The central figure is at a forge engaged in smithing activities, surrounded by flames and tools. The room has patterned floors, a decorative window, and a large basin in the foreground. The drawing showcases detailed human forms, line work, and shading.

artworks.title: Venus Reclining with Vulcan at His Forge
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a workshop scene. There is a figure reclining on a bed with heavy drapery, and another figure working at a forge. The reclining figure is draped in fabrics and resting on cushions. The background includes curtains, ornate bedding, and a tiled floor. The working figure is muscular, focused on hammering at an anvil. Flames in the background suggest heat from the forge. The drawing includes a pitcher, basin, and sculptural elements in the workspace.

artworks.title: Madonna and Child Enthroned, Saint Jerome and Saint Francis
artworks.artist: Anton Maria Zanetti I, after Parmigianino
artworks.medium: color chiaroscuro woodcut on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows three figures in an elaborate scene. In the center, a woman is seated holding a child on her lap. The woman has a serene expression, styled hair, and wears a long robe. The child is naked. To the left of the woman, a man kneels looking up at her, wearing a robe with a cross. To the right of the woman, another figure stands reading a book, with a beard and wearing a robe. The background is detailed with architectural elements, a cloudy sky, and foliage. A skull and a cross are near the central pedestal.

artworks.title: Diana and Her Nymphs in a Garden
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: diameter (trimmed to borderline, with part of image lost at upper right): 19.6 cm (7 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The circular drawing depicts various figures in flowing robes surrounded by trees and clouds. A central reclining figure lies on the ground, while other figures interact nearby. One figure gestures towards a small animal, possibly a dog, sniffing the ground. In the background, more figures walk among the trees. Above them, a seated figure is depicted in the clouds. The landscape includes sparse vegetation and a distant vista with more figures, clouds, and mountains. The style is reminiscent of Renaissance engravings, with detailed line work and an emphasis on classical forms and symmetry.

artworks.title: The Annunciation
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures. The figure on the left is seated and facing slightly towards the right. She has a serene facial expression with her eyes downcast. Her hair is covered with a veil and she is wearing a long gown. The environment includes a bench or pedestal she is seated on and an open book nearby. The figure on the right is kneeling on the ground, facing the seated figure. This person has wavy hair falling to their shoulders and wings attached to their back. They hold a long stem with flowers in one hand. In the background, there are clouds and rays of light emanating from a central point where a dove is depicted, surrounded by several small cherubic figures with wings. The background engraving portrays cherubs and bearded figures within the clouds.

artworks.title: The Group at the Fireplace
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an indoor setting. The scene is dimly lit, with no visible people. The drawing shows furniture in the room, with shadows and contrasts created by intricate cross-hatching. The strokes and details depict the mood of the space with an expressive style. The overall tone is subdued yet rich with texture.

artworks.title: The Smoker
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a seated figure engaged in a task. The image is rendered in fine black lines with cross-hatching for depth. The figure is seated on a wooden chair with one foot resting on a low platform. They wear loose clothing and a hat partially covers their face as they focus on their task. The drawing portrays a sense of solitude and diligence, with detailed clothing folds and shadowing.

artworks.title: Young Artist with a Statue of Cupid
artworks.description: The image shows a young person seated on a wooden chair, facing sideways, with their head bent and resting on their hand. The person is reading an open book, wearing a long coat or robe, with a slightly tousled hairstyle. Next to them are various sculptural elements, including an unfinished cherub-like figure. The background displays a dark wall with fabric or papers on a shelf.

artworks.title: Study for "Surprise" (Battle of the Tigers)
artworks.description: The image shows swirling lines and shapes creating an abstract composition. Some outlines suggest forms of horses and human figures in a dynamic scene reminiscent of a battle or chase. The interwoven figures give an impression of movement and energy, some shapes resembling horse bodies and riders. The abstract artwork invites the viewer to explore the forms amidst the tangle of lines.
